dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Why, hello there, you two! You're ready for the alchemy ranking exam now.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: The exam has four levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and Expert.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: To pass, all you need to do is brew a potion within the time limit that satisfies the main objective.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Satisfying additional objectives will earn you extra rewards.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Just let me know when you're ready.
